cards.title: 封面-蒙眼下山
cards.prompt: A person blindfolded walking down a misty mountain slope, each step carefully feeling the steepest downward direction, cinematic lighting, purple and blue tones, abstract geometric overlay showing gradient arrows, minimal style illustration, no text, 3:4 vertical

cards.title: 学习率对比
cards.prompt: Split comparison illustration: left side shows a tiny figure taking huge leaps overshooting a valley bottom and bouncing between hills, right side shows a figure taking tiny ant-sized steps slowly crawling down the same mountain, minimalist vector style, purple and blue gradient background, no text, 3:4 vertical

cards.title: 梯度即坡度
cards.prompt: A 3D mathematical landscape surface with glowing gradient arrows pointing downhill, the surface is smooth and colorful like a topographic map with purple blue and cyan tones, a small glowing dot at the top representing current position, futuristic data visualization style, no text, 3:4 vertical

cards.title: 三步走
cards.prompt: Three-step visual flow: step 1 shows a compass pointing downhill, step 2 shows a ruler measuring step length, step 3 shows a footprint at a new lower position, connected by flowing arrows, minimalist infographic style, dark purple background with cyan accents, no text, 3:4 vertical

cards.title: 公式直觉
cards.prompt: Abstract visualization of the gradient descent formula theta_new = theta_old - alpha * gradient, where mathematical symbols dissolve into intuitive objects: theta becomes a person on a hill, alpha becomes a shoe, gradient becomes a slope arrow, minus sign becomes a downward direction, dark blue background with glowing white and cyan elements, no text, artistic mathematical illustration, 3:4 vertical

cards.title: 系列预告
cards.prompt: A winding path through a mathematical landscape leading toward a bright glowing horizon, the path passes through stations labeled with glowing icons: a downward arrow, a chain link, a target, a spotlight, and a brain, purple to cyan gradient sky, dreamy illustration style, no text, 3:4 vertical
